class.name: JarBodyAtmosphere
class.brief_description: A physically based atmosphere around a round body.
class.description: Rayleigh and Mie single scattering: blue sky and red sunsets from the ground, a glowing rim from space, haze over distant terrain. Drawn after other transparent objects, so water and clouds get hazed too. Hidden on flat bodies.
